lastResponse.text: Yes, this is an emergency. Call nine one one right now. Those long gaps can mean overdose or breathing failure. Stay with him, put him on his side, and keep his airway clear. If he stops breathing or you can’t feel breath, start CPR immediately. I’m here with you, but call nine one one now.
originalTexts: Yes, this is an emergency. **Call 911 right now.** Those long gaps can mean overdose or breathing failure. Stay with him, put him on his side, and keep his airway clear. If he stops breathing or you can’t feel breath, start CPR immediately. I’m here with you, but call **911 now**.
